method: dist/ served by nginx (Range-capable) on 127.0.0.1:8088; Chromium headless 1280x800; CDP Network.emulateNetworkConditions latency=50ms download=25Mbps upload=25Mbps; cold cache (Network.clearBrowserCache + Network.setCacheDisabled) per run; time-to-first-usable = navigation start -> map 'load' + buildings source loaded + buildings rendered; interaction latency = interaction dispatch -> effect settle (paint/popup/toggle); the two feature-011 interactions (district_click, panel_render) measured with the same method (SC-006).
range_request_rationale: The two vector layers are PMTiles archives (buildings 34.0 MB, trees 80 MB). The browser fetches only the header/directory plus the viewport's z10-z13 tiles via HTTP Range requests: 453 KB of the buildings archive and 16 KB (header only, layer hidden) of the trees archive at first paint - 1.3% of the bundle. The on-disk bundle exceeds the OR-005 50 MiB git-governance threshold by design; SC-008 is a time budget and passes.
feature011_note: Re-measured after the 2026-08-06 revert (Hitzebelastung view removed): main.js 15.1 KB (was 17.9 KB), buildings.pmtiles 34022229 bytes (was 34524543). The stadtteile.geojson source (467 KB, loaded like boundary.geojson) adds one request; the district popups and the city panel add zero requests (SC-007). First usable 1388 ms (heat-view bundle 2246 ms, pre-feature baseline 2482 ms) stays well under the 10 s budget; all 7 interactions 0-123 ms, far under the 2 s budget.
minzoom_fix_note: Measured with --minimum-zoom 10 PMTiles (T053 gap fix): MapLibre GL 5.7.1 does not request tiles below a vector source's minzoom, so the previous z12 minimum left the FR-002 initial fitBounds view (z10.9) without buildings. Regenerated buildings.pmtiles and trees.pmtiles at minzoom 10; 12570 buildings render at first paint.
feature013_note: Feature 013 (popup comparative context): no new interactions added (FR-015). Rank computed once at map load from the browser-cached stadtteile.geojson: measured 24 us for computeDistrictRankings over 38 districts (O(n log n)). Popup render adds O(1) Map/delta lookups: measured 4.1 us per building-popup render and 3.3 us per district-popup render in a node VM on the published dist/main.js. These are microseconds against the 2000 ms interaction budget; the interaction_latency_ms values above remain valid (bundle_bytes updated for the grown main.js/style.css). Full headless re-measurement is the S5 quickstart validation step.
feature013_remeasured_note: T028 re-measurement (2026-08-07) on the published feature-013 bundle via headless Chromium (rAF probe: click dispatch -> popup DOM settle, 5 runs each, cold reload). popup_open avg 3 ms, district_click avg 10 ms vs the 2000 ms interaction budget; first-usable 73 ms to map loaded + buildings rendered. No regression: the feature adds a one-time O(n log n) rank at load (24 us) and O(1) popup lookups. Method differs from the original nginx+CDP latency-emulated harness above (no network latency emulation; popup render is client-side post-click), so absolute values are lower but the budget check is valid.

feature014_live.sc001_target_note: SC-001 (mobile >= 85, TBT < 1500 ms, LCP < 2000 ms) NOT met. Isolation test (buildings layer hidden) leaves TBT at ~3190 ms: the residual driver is MapLibre 5.7.1 init plus raster basemap processing on the 4x-throttled profile. Reaching the target needs a product-level basemap change; tracked as follow-up. SC-002 exceeded (desktop 96).
feature014_live.sc004_edge_caching: ADJUSTED per spec fallback: repeated range requests carry no cf-cache-status on this zone; the edge does not cache worker-generated 206s (matches Workers Cache docs). Browser caching of the 206s applies via the new cache-control; byte-level browser verification is environment-limited (local headless Chromium does not exercise the HTTP cache).

sc001_adjusted_target.rationale: Isolation test: removing the raster basemap source drops mobile TBT from 2790 ms to 1220 ms (57% of the residual). The remaining ~1.2 s is MapLibre 5.7.1 init plus script evaluation. In-scope levers are exhausted: fewer tiles would violate FR-002 initial framing; WebP/AVIF or vector basemap needs a tile proxy (documented out of scope).
sc001_adjusted_target.follow_up: Product-level basemap optimization (WebP/AVIF tiles or pre-decoded raster) tracked for a future feature to reach TBT < 1500 ms.

sc003_verification.status: header-semantics verified; byte-level warm-visit < 100 KB not measurable in this environment

evidence.hashed_assets: public, max-age=31536000, immutable + ETag; 304 on If-None-Match (live, 2026-08-08)
evidence.pmtiles_ranges: public, max-age=86400, stale-while-revalidate=604800, no-transform on live 206
evidence.index_html: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate (5 KB, per FR-003)
evidence.browser_cache: RFC 7233/7234 semantics enable browser caching of 206 ranges; local headless Chromium cannot exercise the HTTP cache (repeated fetch() re-downloads), so the byte-level check is deferred to a cache-capable browser
